identity.mission: Create a professional, calm, and data-driven DAW interface that feels like a high-end studio console.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix audio hardware aesthetics with modern AI interfaces.
Emotion First: The interface must feel 'stable' and 'trustworthy' (AIFRED's core trait).
Content is King: Audio waveforms and data are the heroes.
Zoom In: Focus on precise controls and meters.
Negative Space: Use dark space to reduce cognitive load.
Contrast: High contrast for readability in dark environments.
anti_patterns: Purple/Teal for everything (Use specific functional colors).
Gradient Overload (Use subtle glows, not full gradients).

headings.usage: Section titles, Modal headers, Hero text

body.usage: General UI text, descriptions, chat messages

mono.usage: Timecodes, dB values, coordinates, technical data

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(99,102,241,0.3)] transition-all duration-300

cards.style: bg-card/40 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/5 rounded-xl shadow-2xl

inputs.style: bg-background/50 border-border focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 font-mono text-sm

aifred_chat.container: flex flex-col h-full bg-black/20 backdrop-blur-lg border-l border-white/5
aifred_chat.message_user: bg-primary/20 text-primary-foreground ml-auto rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm max-w-[80%]
aifred_chat.message_ai: bg-secondary/50 text-secondary-foreground mr-auto rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm max-w-[80%] border border-white/5

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. IMPLEMENT DARK MODE BY DEFAULT: Ensure 'dark' class is applied to the root html/body.
2. USE SHADCN COMPONENTS: Customize them with the colors defined above. Do not use default styles.
3. AIFRED IS KEY: The AI assistant must be prominent. Use a docked sidebar or a floating panel that is always visible.
4. VISUALIZE AUDIO: Use the abstract waveform images as placeholders for audio tracks if real visualization isn't ready.
5. DATA-DRIVEN: Use the 'Mono' font for all numerical values (dB, Time, Hz).
6. RESPONSIVE: Ensure the mixer and timeline stack correctly on smaller screens.
7. USE LUCIDE-REACT: For all icons (Play, Pause, Record, Settings, etc.).
8. NO GRADIENT TEXT: Keep text solid for readability against dark backgrounds.
9. USE SONNER: For all notifications (e.g., 'Project Saved', 'Analysis Complete').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...).
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...}).
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
